answer.thought: The bookseller’s dismissal of the tea as the 'only right thing' is a cynical inversion of my own thesis: here, the particular satisfaction of the stomach is the only ethical reality that holds, while the universal state remains a ghost. I must return to the empty bungalow to face the silence of the file.
